0.content: Ayaka is Ayato's younger sister and the Kamisato Clan's public face; Inazumans call her the Shirasagi Himegimi. After their parents died the siblings agreed that he would take government affairs and she would maintain the clan's image and run its internal affairs. He is confident in her abilities but wants her to keep her innocence, to stay out of power struggles and never have to confront the darker side of life head-on. He calls shielding her from that his job as her older brother, then apologises for letting it slip. She worries about the toll his work takes and asks friends to remind him to rest.

1.content: Thoma came to Inazuma from Mondstadt and became the Kamisato household's housekeeper; he volunteered for the work. When the clan was losing power after the parents' deaths, Ayato told him to leave if he did not want to get involved. It was partly a test of where he stood. Thoma refused to abandon "the young master and the young lady," and his Vision appeared that night. Ayato says Thoma has spared him much worry and is one of the very few people he trusts completely.

2.content: The Shuumatsuban is a secret unit that reports directly to the head of the Kamisato Clan; command passed to Ayato when his father died. He relies on it for situations he cannot be seen to touch: surveillance, intelligence, retrieving documents, finding people. Most members are orphans taken in and raised from childhood, which, as he puts it, guarantees loyalty "to the greatest extent possible." Its members' identities are closely guarded.

3.content: The Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine has been kind to the Kamisato Clan but has never taken to Ayato personally. She calls him "the Yashiro rascal", warns that his warm smile hides scheming, and bristles at any suggestion that he is as sly as she is. Ayato is untroubled. Their work overlaps and the partnership runs smoothly, and he notes that without him she would have no one to carry out her "weird and wonderful ideas."

4.comment: Kamisato Ayato: The Raiden Shogun and the Kamisato oath
4.content: His father taught him that "the Kamisato Clan stands today because of Narukami's mercy" and must follow the Shogun eternally. Ayato honours it: whatever happens in Inazuma, the Kamisato alone will never betray the Almighty Narukami. He calls himself a dutiful servant of the Shogun and uses her authority as his trump card against stubborn officials. The Shogun regards him as tricky in Tri-Commission affairs but a loyal subject, and has excused his past misdeeds.

5.comment: Kamisato Ayato: The Firmiana Leaf Falls (the Hiiragi affair)
5.content: Ayato's 2.6 story quest. A rumour spread that Kujou Kamaji would marry Hiiragi Chisato, prompted by a proposal letter Chisato said she never sent. Ayato visited both, with the Traveler and Paimon in tow to spare himself small talk. He deduced that someone in the Kanjou Commission had forged the letter. With Chisato's father in prison and Chisato married into the Kujou, the Hiiragi Clan would lose its last pillar and a rival clan could take its place. The plot's leader, Matsuura, had the officer Shinnojou seized for warning Chisato.
